questions.stem: The bearing of $Q$ from $P$ is $315°$. What is the bearing of $P$ from $Q$?
questions.explanation: The back bearing is $315° - 180° = 135°$. When the original bearing is greater than $180°$, subtract $180°$.

questions.stem: A ship sails on a bearing of $120°$ for $10\text{ km}$, then turns to a bearing of $210°$ for $8\text{ km}$. After the first leg, in which general direction has the ship been travelling?
questions.explanation: A bearing of $120°$ is between East ($090°$) and South ($180°$), so the direction is South-East.

questions.stem: Town $B$ is due East of town $A$. Town $C$ is on a bearing of $150°$ from $A$. What is the angle $\angle BAC$?
questions.explanation: Due East from $A$ is a bearing of $090°$. The bearing to $C$ is $150°$. The angle between these two directions is $150° - 090° = 60°$.
